title: If only Mojang...
description: 1.21.1 NeoForge 💩 Corrected the negative aspects of the game in my opinion without breaking the original meaning
body:
Improved cauldrons, diorite, granite, and andesite. New reversed biomes in the nether, caves, removed telemetry, tweaks, visual, sustained horror, content of new updates. The ability for piglins to live in the overworld. It's a shame I still haven't found a mod to add villages for them in Overworld

This is modpack for me and my friends. Test on PoJava/MoJava, NeoForge 1.21.1
